en: A vintage Spanish postal card with brownish paper and red printed text. It shows a red pre-printed stamp on the right side with cancellation marks and a circular postmark reading 'MADRID' and a date. The heading reads 'TARJETA POSTAL' and 'UNIÓN UNIVERSAL DE CORREOS (CARTE POSTALE–UNION POSTALE UNIVERSELLE)' with 'ESPAÑA' beneath. There is an ornate Spanish coat of arms on the left. The card is filled in with black handwritten address text, and at the bottom left there is a printed note in Spanish indicating that only the address should be written on this side. A small modern label at the lower left reads 'M.C.D.2020'.
